overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（3 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以回归分析、固定效应为主。来源分布：arXiv（6 篇）、OpenAlex（4 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。

papers.title: The Two Cultures of Prevalence Mapping: Small Area Estimation and Model-Based Geostatistics
papers.abstract: In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), accurate estimates of subnational health and demographic indicators are critical for guiding policy and identifying disparities. Many indicators of interest are proportions of binary outcomes and the task of estimating these fractions is often called prevalence mapping. In LMICs, health and vital records data are limited, so prevalence mapping relies on data from household surveys with complex sampling designs. However, estimates are often desired at spatial resolutions at which data are insufficient for reliable weighted estimation. We review two families of approaches to prevalence mapping: small area estimation (SAE) methods (from the survey statistics literature) and model-based geostatistics (MBG) methods (from the spatial statistics literature). SAE models can be “area-level” or “unit-level” and commonly use area-specific random effects and rely upon high-quality covariate data, often obtained from administrative sources. Unit-level models for binary responses are relatively underdeveloped. MBG approaches explicitly specify binary response models, incorporate continuous spatial random effects, and leverage alternative sources of data such as those arising from satellite imagery. These models are usually studied within a Bayesian framework. SAE methods often address the design by incorporating sampling weights or modeling the sampling mechanism. Two delicate issues arise when using MBG methods for prevalence mapping. First, aggregating unit-level predictions to create area-level summaries requires population-level information that is rarely directly available. Second, MBG approaches typically assume the sampling design is ignorable. We review both SAE and MBG approaches to prevalence mapping, and argue that binary response models can be improved using insights from both the survey sampling and the spatial statistics literature. We highlight these issues using household survey data from the Zambia 2018 Demographic Health Survey to estimate subnational HIV prevalence for women aged 15–49.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），准确估计次国家级别的健康和人口统计指标对于制定政策及识别健康差异至关重要。许多需要关注的指标都是二元结果的比例，而估算这些比例的过程通常被称为“患病率制图”（prevalence mapping）。在这些国家，健康和生命记录数据较为有限，因此患病率制图主要依赖于采用复杂抽样设计进行的家庭调查数据。然而，往往需要在空间分辨率较高的情况下进行估算，但此时现有数据不足以支持可靠的加权估计。本文综述了两种用于患病率制图的方法：小区域估计（Small Area Estimation, SAE）方法（源自调查统计领域）和基于模型的地理统计学（Model-Based Geostatistics, MBG）方法（源自空间统计领域）。SAE模型可以是“区域级”或“单元级”的，通常使用特定区域的随机效应，并依赖于高质量的协变量数据（这些数据多来自行政来源）；而针对二元响应的单元级模型则相对较少发展。MBG方法明确指定了二元响应模型，同时纳入了连续的空间随机效应，并能够利用卫星图像等替代数据源，这些模型通常在贝叶斯框架下进行研究。SAE方法常通过加入抽样权重或对抽...。研究方法：随机效应、贝叶斯方法、调查数据。

papers.title: On the Minimum Strength of (Unobserved) Covariates to Overturn an Insignificant Result
papers.abstract: We study conditions under which the addition of variables to a regression equation can turn a previously statistically insignificant result into a significant one. Specifically, we characterize the minimum strength of association required for these variables—both with the dependent and independent variables, or with the dependent variable alone—to elevate the observed t-statistic above a specified significance threshold. Interestingly, we show that it is considerably difficult to overturn a statistically insignificant result solely by reducing the standard error. Instead, included variables must also alter the point estimate to achieve such reversals in practice. Our results can be used to conduct sensitivity analyses against unobserved variables and to bound the maximum t-value one can obtain given different subsets of observed covariates, and may also offer algebraic explanations for patterns of reversals seen in empirical research, such as those documented by Lenz and Sahn (Polit. Anal. 29 (2021) 356–369).
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了在何种条件下，向回归方程中添加变量能够使原本统计上不显著的结论变得显著。具体而言，我们确定了这些变量与因变量、自变量或仅与因变量之间的最小关联强度，以使观察到的t统计量超过预设的显著性阈值。有趣的是，我们发现仅通过减小标准误差来改变统计结果几乎是不可能的；实际上，必须同时改变点估计值才能实现这种转变。我们的研究结果可用于针对未观测变量进行敏感性分析，并确定在给定不同观测协变量子集的情况下所能获得的最大t值。此外，这些结果还可能为实证研究中观察到的某些变化模式提供代数解释，例如Lenz和Sahn（Polit. Anal. 29 (2021) 356–369）所记录的现象。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Causal inference in staggered adoption panels: The correct comparison set depends on your intervention
papers.abstract: A powerful data structure for causal inference is staggered adoption: many units are observed over many time periods, during which some units adopt an irreversible treatment at various time points while others remain untreated. Popular methods that apply in this setting include difference in difference, fixed effects, matching, and synthetic control. All of these methods compare the future outcomes of treatment adopters and non-adopters to answer the question: for units who adopt treatment, what outcomes would have been realized if they had remained untreated? We show that this question actually hides two very different causal questions of interest. The first is what would have happened under a momentary intervention to prevent treatment at its factual adoption time. The second is what would have happened to a treated unit under a longitudinal ban preventing treatment at all periods until outcome measurement. We show how to answer each question under conditionally ignorable treatment adoption or under parallel trends. We highlight that common methods cannot answer the second question because this question requires a time-varying comparison set with time-varying weights.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】一种用于因果推断的强大数据结构是“交错采纳”（staggered adoption）：许多单元在多个时间段内被观察，其中一些单元在不同时间点接受了不可逆的处理，而另一些单元则未接受任何处理。在这一背景下常用的方法包括差异-in-differences（DID）、固定效应模型（fixed effects）、匹配（matching）和合成控制（synthetic control）。这些方法都是通过比较接受处理与未接受处理的单元的未来结果来回答这样一个问题：对于那些接受了处理的单元，如果它们没有接受处理，将会出现什么样的结果？我们指出，这个问题实际上隐藏了两个截然不同的因果研究问题。第一个问题是：如果在实际接受处理的时间点立即实施干预措施来阻止该处理，会发生什么？第二个问题是：如果对一个已经接受处理的单元实施长期禁令，在所有测量结果的时间点之前都禁止该处理，那么这个单元的情况会如何？我们展示了在处理采纳具有条件可忽略性（conditionally ignorable treatment adoption）或存在平行趋势（parallel trends）的情况下，如何回答这两个问题。我们...。研究方法：合成控制法、因果推断、固定效应。

papers.title: A Resource Allocation Tournament
papers.abstract: We introduce and analyze a round-robin simultaneous resource allocation contest, motivated by sports leagues and other competitive environments where agents must distribute limited resources across multiple encounters. Players allocate resources in advance to matches against all opponents, and match outcomes are determined by relative allocations. We study two payoff schemes: total points, where players accumulate rewards for each win, and winner-takes-all, where only the tournament winner is rewarded. For three players, we provide complete equilibrium characterizations under both schemes. For four or more players, we show that the total points payoff admits Blotto-type equilibria, while the winner-takes-all payoff requires numerical and algorithmic analysis. To address this, we develop a best-response dynamics algorithm with stochastic inertia and use it to approximate equilibria in games with four and five players.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文研究了一个受体育联赛启发的资源分配锦标赛，探讨代理人在多场遭遇战中如何分配有限资源以最大化收益，并比较了“总积分”与“赢家通吃”两种不同的支付方案。

🔬 研究方法：研究通过博弈论分析，对3名及4名及以上玩家的模型进行了均衡求解，并开发了一种带有随机惯性的最佳响应动态算法来近似求解复杂情况下的均衡。

📊 核心发现：对于3名玩家，研究给出了两种支付方案下的完整均衡特征；对于4名及以上玩家，发现“总积分”方案存在Blotto型均衡，而“赢家通吃”方案则需要数值算法分析。

💡 应用价值：该研究为理解体育联赛及其他竞争环境中的资源分配策略提供了理论框架，并开发的方法可用于解决

papers.title: Workforce Aging and Firm Productivity: Evidence from Türkiye
papers.venue: Review of Middle East Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: Abstract Does workforce aging lower firm productivity? We study this question for a large emerging economy using matched employer–employee records from Türkiye linked to firm balance sheets over 2013–2023, roughly 1.75 million firm–year observations. Identifying the relationship from within-firm variation, we find that a higher share of older workers is associated with modestly lower productivity: a one-unit increase in the share of workers aged 50 and above lowers value added per worker by about 8.3 %. Much of the larger raw correlation reflects sorting of younger workforces into more productive firms, but a precise negative effect survives selection. The average conceals pronounced heterogeneity: the penalty is about 11 % in manufacturing and routine-intensive services, roughly half as large in construction and trade, and statistically absent in agriculture. Interacting the firm’s age composition with task scores confirms the mechanism: the penalty is attenuated where non-routine interpersonal content is high and amplified where routine and analytical content are high. What matters is less the age of a workforce than the work it performs. This is among the first firm-level evidence on aging and productivity for a large emerging economy.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】摘要：劳动力老龄化是否会降低企业生产率？我们利用2013至2023年间土耳其的雇主-员工匹配数据以及企业资产负债表，对这一问题在大型新兴经济体中进行了研究，共计涵盖了约175万个企业-年份的观测样本。通过分析企业内部劳动力的年龄结构，我们发现老年员工占比越高，企业生产率越低：50岁及以上员工占比每增加一个百分点，人均附加值就会下降约8.3%。虽然总体相关性较高，但这在很大程度上是由于年轻劳动力被分配到了生产率更高的企业中；但在经过筛选后，这种负面效应仍然存在。平均来看，老龄化对生产率的负面影响在制造业和常规密集型服务业中最为显著（约为11%），在建筑业和贸易业中则减弱至约一半，而在农业行业中则几乎不存在这种影响。将企业的年龄结构与工作任务的特点相结合后，我们进一步验证了这一机制：当工作中包含较多的非常规人际互动内容时，老龄化对生产率的负面影响会减弱；而当工作中包含较多常规性和分析性任务时，负面影响则会加剧。实际上，影响生产率的关键因素并非劳动力的年龄，而是他们所从事的工作类型。这是针对大型新兴经济体首次在企业层面获得的关于老龄化与生产率关系的研究证据之一。。

papers.title: ASSESSING TAX CONSEQUENCES AND RISKS OF ANALYTICAL MISINTERPRETATION OF BOOK-TAX DIFFERENCES IN ARMENIAN ELECTRICITY-SECTOR COMPANIES
papers.abstract: This study examines the tax consequences of book-tax differences and the risk of analytical misinterpretation using 2016–2025 data from three Armenian electricity-sector companies. The empirical design combines effective tax rate reconciliation, cross-document reconciliation of current tax, a multi-stage reconciliation of net deferred tax positions, gross-versus-net deferred tax analysis, and a descriptive sensitivity measure for the use of carried-forward tax losses. The findings show that extreme effective tax rates should not be treated as stand-alone evidence of tax aggressiveness or elevated tax risk. In 5 of 30 company-year observations (16.7%), the year-to-year change in the net deferred tax position cannot be fully reconciled to deferred tax recognized in profit or loss alone. In 2022, High Voltage Electric Networks reported a net deferred tax liability of AMD 44.9 million while its gross deferred tax asset and liability balances totaled AMD 3.6 billion, illustrating the informational limitation of net presentation. In 8 of 15 observations involving the use of prior-period tax losses (53.3%), separating the carried-forward tax effect changes the inferred direction of the book-tax difference. The findings support a distinction between tax risk and the risk of analytical misinterpretation and provide the basis for a multi-stage book-tax reconciliation framework.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本研究利用2016至2025年间三家亚美尼亚电力行业公司的数据，探讨了账面税与实际税差异所带来的税务后果以及由此可能导致的分析误解风险。研究采用了多种方法进行实证分析，包括有效税率的核对、当期税款的跨文档比对、递延税项的多阶段核对、递延税项的总额与净额分析，以及对税前亏损结转使用的敏感性评估。研究结果表明，过高的有效税率不应被单独视为企业具有税收激进行为或较高税务风险的依据。在30个公司年度数据样本中，有5个样本（占16.7%）的年度递延税项变化无法仅通过利润或损失中的递延税项来完全解释。以High Voltage Electric Networks为例，2022年其报告的递延税负债为4490万亚美尼亚德拉姆，而其递延税资产与负债的总额却高达36亿亚美尼亚德拉姆，这凸显了仅使用递延税项净额信息所带来的局限性。在涉及税前亏损结转的15个样本中，有8个样本（占53.3%），区分税前亏损结转的影响会改变对账面税差异的判断方向。研究结果支持将税务风险与分析误解风险区分开来，并为构建多阶段的账面税差异核对框架提供了依据。。

papers.title: Economic lifetime-aware wind farm control
papers.abstract: We present the economic lifetime-aware formulation of wind farm control (WFC), a novel approach characterized by two key innovations with respect to the state of the art. First, the optimization is guided by an economic model of profit. By targeting profit instead of the more widely adopted power yield, the operational optimization considers not only the revenue generated by selling electricity (possibly at a variable price when operating on spot markets) but also the costs due to operation and maintenance (O&M). Second, since fatigue-induced damage is a finite-budget quantity, we explicitly consider that any effect on damage generated by a control action will leave more or less room to other control actions, a coupling that is neglected by current approaches that arbitrarily limit or penalize fatigue-inducing loads. To achieve this goal, the optimization is subjected to explicit constraints on lifetime, which ensure that the turbines in a farm and their components can indeed reach a desired goal duration. As for other optimization-based WFC approaches, the proposed method results in the offline calculation of optimal control set points for each turbine, which are scheduled and dispatched at run time in an open loop as functions of ambient conditions. After introducing the economic lifetime-aware WFC approach, the paper analyzes two case studies. The first represents an idealized scenario characterized by a simplified set of environmental conditions, designed to demonstrate the behavior of the new control strategy and its impact on fatigue loads in conditions of very frequent waking. The second case features a more realistic small wind farm, with wind climate data derived from an existing meteorological mast. The benefits of the proposed methodology are highlighted by comparing it to alternative, previously published control strategies, which either ignore component damage or address fatigue loads in alternative, simplified ways. Results show that the lifetime-aware formulation always ensures the achievement of the desired lifetime targets, whereas methods that do not enforce such a condition may fail to do so. Additionally, the proposed method also results in the best economic performance, i.e., in the highest profit.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种基于经济寿命考虑的风电场控制（WFC）方法，该方法在多个方面实现了创新。首先，优化过程以经济利润模型为指导，而非普遍采用的发电量作为目标。通过关注利润而非发电量，运营优化不仅考虑了售电收入（在现货市场可能以变动价格出售电力），还考虑了运营和维护（O&M）成本。其次，由于疲劳引起的损伤是一个受预算限制的变量，我们明确指出控制措施对损伤的影响会为其他控制措施留下相应的空间；而现有方法通常会任意限制或惩罚导致疲劳的负荷，忽略了这种耦合关系。为实现这一目标，优化过程受到寿命的明确约束，确保风电场中的风力涡轮机及其部件能够达到预期的使用寿命。与其他基于优化的WFC方法类似，所提出的方法会预先计算出每台涡轮机的最优控制参数，并根据环境条件在运行时以开环方式调度这些参数。在介绍了这种基于经济寿命考虑的WFC方法后，论文分析了两个案例研究：第一个案例采用简化的环境条件，用于展示新控制策略的性能及其对频繁启动情况下疲劳负荷的影响；第二个案例则基于实际气象数据，模拟了一个小型风电场的运行情况。通过与以往发布的控制策略进行比较，突显了该方法的优势——这些传统策略要么忽略部件损伤，要么以简...。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Retrofitters, pragmatists, and activists: public interest litigation for accountable automated decision-making
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  This paper examines the role of public interest litigation in promoting accountability for AI and automated decision-making (ADM) in Australia. Since ADM regulation faces political and geopolitical headwinds, effective governance will have to rely on the enforcement of existing laws. Drawing on interviews with Australian public interest litigators, technology policy activists, and technology law scholars, the paper positions public interest litigation as part of a larger ecosystem for transparency, accountability, and justice with respect to ADM. The paper explores the tactics and strategies of what one participant described as “retrofitting” old laws to ADM. These go beyond creative legal argumentation to encompass practices of community-building, collaboration on theories of change, canny selection of clients and causes of action, and careful alignment of the interests of stakeholders in litigation. Naturally, the paper also contends with the limits of these strategies, and of the Australian legal system. Where limits are, however, capable of being overcome, the paper presents findings on urgent needs: the enabling institutional arrangements without which effective litigation and accountability will falter. The paper is relevant to law and technology scholars; individuals and groups harmed by ADM; public interest litigators and technology lawyers; civil society and advocacy organizations; and policymakers.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
本文探讨了公益诉讼在推动澳大利亚人工智能（AI）与自动化决策（ADM）领域问责制方面的作用。由于ADM监管面临政治和地缘政治方面的阻碍，有效的治理机制必须依赖于现有法律的执行。通过采访澳大利亚的公益诉讼律师、技术政策活动家和技术法律学者，本文将公益诉讼视为促进ADM透明度、问责制与正义的更大体系的一部分。文章分析了某些参与者所提出的“改造”现有法律以适应ADM需求的策略与方法，这些方法不仅包括创新的法律论证，还涵盖社区建设、变革理论的合作探讨、对诉讼对象及诉讼理由的精心选择，以及平衡诉讼各方利益的做法。当然，本文也指出了这些策略及澳大利亚法律体系的局限性。在能够克服这些局限性的情况下，文章提出了亟需解决的制度性问题——缺乏相应的制度安排，有效的诉讼与问责机制将难以发挥作用。本文对法律和技术领域的学者、受ADM影响的个人与群体、公益诉讼律师和技术律师、民间社会组织及政策制定者都具有重要的参考价值。。

papers.title: Beyond city pairs: Higher-order information in urban growth across borders
papers.abstract: We apply higher-order information measures to urban growth across borders and spatial units. We analyse 8,808 functional urban areas using gridded GDP estimates allocated from national accounts. Negative estimated O-information occurs in 29.93% of cross-border triplets and 2.00% of domestic triplets. This fifteen-fold contrast falls to fourfold at comparable dependence strength and persists under data-quality restrictions. Target-specific decompositions show how information overlaps or combines across cities. Administrative subdivisions have mean O-information within matched random-map ranges inside countries. These findings show why interpreting geographic dependence requires specifying comparison cities and spatial units, while economic connections remain to be established independently.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们运用高阶信息度量方法来研究跨国界及不同空间单元之间的城市增长现象。研究分析了8,808个功能城市区域，这些数据基于国家账户中分配的网格化GDP估算值。在29.93%的跨国界城市对以及2.00%的国内城市对中，估算出的O信息值为负。这种十五倍的差异在依赖强度相当的情况下缩减为四倍，并且在数据质量限制条件下依然存在。针对特定目标的分解结果显示了信息在这些城市之间的重叠或结合方式。行政分区在国家内部的随机地图对应范围内具有平均O信息值。这些发现表明，解读地理依赖性时需要明确比较的城市和空间单元；而经济联系则仍需另行独立验证。。

papers.title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
papers.abstract: This study uses a high-frequency dataset from a stock exchange to examine how forecasting ability and liquidity provision relate to institutional traders' proprietary intraday profitability. We discover persistent forecasting abilities among traders. Specifically, we demonstrate that hypothetical flow-following strategies based on the execution flows of these skillful traders yield annualized Sharpe ratios ranging from 16 to 63 across various trading frequencies. We match buy and sell executions into positions, linking realized profit and loss (P&L) to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and the liquidity roles of both executions. Our findings indicate a direct correlation between improved forecasting ability and profitability, where a one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting ability proxy is associated with 1.02 -- 1.19 currency units higher P&L per matched position. Additionally, we measure liquidity-provision intensity within a matched position by its number of passive executions: zero, one, or two. In these regressions, P&L is 1.28 -- 1.31 currency units higher for one passive execution than for none, and a further 3.79 -- 3.82 higher for two than for one, underscoring the significant financial benefits of liquidity provision.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】本研究利用来自证券交易所的高频数据集，探讨了预测能力与流动性供给如何影响机构交易者的日内盈利能力。研究发现，交易者普遍具备持续的预测能力。具体而言，基于这些熟练交易者的成交行为所设计的策略在各种交易频率下均实现了16%至63%的年化夏普比率（Sharpe Ratio）。我们将买卖成交行为与相应的头寸相匹配，将实际盈亏（P&L）与预测指标以及这两种成交行为的流动性作用联系起来。研究结果表明，预测能力的提升与盈利能力之间存在直接关联：预测能力指标每提高一个标准差，每个匹配头寸的盈亏会增加1.02至1.19个货币单位。此外，我们通过被动成交的数量（零次、一次或两次）来衡量头寸内的流动性供给强度。回归分析显示，每个头寸中包含一次被动成交时，盈亏比不含被动成交时高出1.28至1.31个货币单位；而包含两次被动成交时，盈亏比则高出3.79至3.82个货币单位，这进一步凸显了流动性供给所带来的显著财务收益。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Testing for peer effects in short panels without identifying the network structure
papers.abstract: We propose an instrument-based test for peer effects in short-T panels when the underlying network is unknown. The test avoids estimating the network by aggregating pairwise comparisons between covariate-projected outcomes of potential peers and residualized own outcomes. The statistic is designed for fixed-T, large-N settings with individual fixed effects, heterogeneous slopes, heteroskedasticity, and serial dependence within units. We also develop a weighted extension that accounts for additive common time effects. The limiting distribution is standard Gaussian when the norm of the projected component of the outcomes is bounded away from zero, but can be nonstandard when it is local to zero. We derive a conditional Gaussian limit experiment and a feasible conditional Monte Carlo procedure to obtain uniformly valid critical values. Monte Carlo evidence shows that the conditional procedure leads to accurate size control while retaining power against latent peer-effect alternatives.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种基于工具变量的检验方法，用于研究在潜在网络结构未知的情况下短期面板数据中的同伴效应。该检验方法通过汇总潜在同伴的协变量投影结果与个体自身残差结果之间的成对比较来避免对网络结构的估计。该方法适用于固定样本量（T固定）、大样本量（N较大）的情境，并考虑了个体固定效应、异质斜率、异方差性以及单元内部的序列相关性。我们还开发了一种加权扩展版本，以纳入共同的时间效应。当结果投影分量的范数不为零时，该检验的极限分布服从标准高斯分布；当投影分量的范数接近零时，极限分布可能不再服从标准高斯分布。我们推导出了条件高斯极限分布，并设计了一种可行的条件蒙特卡洛程序来获得具有统一有效性的临界值。蒙特卡洛模拟结果表明，这种条件检验方法能够在保持对潜在同伴效应假设的检验功效的同时，实现精确的统计功效控制。。研究方法：固定效应、蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Directionally Correct Views in Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract: Portfolio optimization techniques often use historical data to estimate parameters for Markowitz-type or ML models. Effective allocation requires a way to align the available data with conditions expected over the investment horizon. Inspired by the Black-Litterman framework, we ask whether incorporating expert views leads to better portfolio allocations. In a simple Markowitz setting, we show that even a small amount of directionally correct information can materially improve investment decisions. We also discuss how expert views can be incorporated in end-to-end portfolio models using entropy-based ideas. Somewhat surprisingly, our empirical results indicate that simpler Markowitz-type model perform as well as an end-to-end model, once directionally correct experts are incorporated.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】投资组合优化技术通常利用历史数据来估计用于马科维茨模型（Markowitz-type models）或机器学习模型（ML models）的参数。有效的资产配置需要一种方法，将现有数据与投资期限内的预期条件相匹配。受Black-Litterman框架的启发，我们探讨了纳入专家观点是否能够带来更优的投资组合配置。在一个简单的马科维茨模型框架下，我们发现即使是非常少量的、方向正确的信息也能显著改善投资决策。我们还讨论了如何利用基于熵（entropy-based）的原理将专家观点整合到端到端的投资组合模型（end-to-end portfolio models）中。令人有些意外的是，我们的实证结果表明，一旦纳入了方向正确的专家意见，简单的马科维茨模型与端到端模型具有相当的表现。。研究方法：优化方法。
